- **Matched Conditions for this Citizen**:
  • [MATCHED] Resident of India (Citizen State: Andhra Pradesh)

- **Direct Financial Assistance**:
- **Subsidies & Credit Support**:
  • Prime Minister's Rural Development Fellows Scheme (Benefits & Subsidies): Subsidy: Max Percentage: 10
- **Insurance Coverage**:
  • Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-yojana (PM-MKSSY): COMPONENT 1B: One-Time Incentive for the Adoption of Aquaculture Insurance (Eligibility Criteria): State: All

- [ ] Aadhaar Card (linked with active mobile number)
